---
name: 🐜 Bug report
about: Something that's supposed to work does not work, or the program crashes.
---

## Bug Report

Thanks for taking the time to report a problem ❤️  When you report an issue, a developer will likely want to know:
  - what you were trying to do,
  - what happened instead, and
  - how can we reproduce it


📹  A **video recording** is really helpful. If the bug happens when you do _something_ in game, consider adding **step-by-step instructions**.

  - ❎  Bad: "A turtle shell killed me and the game crashed. Why?!???4 reeeEe"
  - ☑️  Good: "I opened map X (see screenshot), and jumped on a flying Koopa. The shell fell to the ground, bounced back from the tile I circled on the image, and when it hit me, the game crashed"

📒  If you know that a feature **used to work**, then finding out when it broke can be helpful. You can find all previous releases [HERE](https://github.com/mmatyas/supermariowar/releases).

🖥️  If you have exotic **platforms or environments**, do mention that.
  - Example: "I'm running Arch Linux on a toaster, with a graphics driver I casually wrote myself, and when I turn on the FluxCondensator kernel module, the game eats my laundry"
  - Example: "I have exactly 543987 maps. For some reason, the game loads slowly"

🛠️  If a bug happens on your personal map or world, try reproducing it on one of the default maps/worlds, or consider attaching it. It helps a lot if a bug can be quickly reproduced.

📜  Note: This game is a free, open source hobby project. People usually work on it in their free time, because it's fun, not because it's their job. Thank you for your understanding!

**If you've read it, feel free to delete the text above when you open the issue!**
